pre_c1_flows.web: PointerEvent/coalesced samples -> JS generation/stroke/brush lifecycle -> WASM/host
pre_c1_flows.android: MotionEvent -> Java/native pointer registry -> Arc InputSource -> host
pre_c1_flows.windows: WM_POINTER history -> platform registry/disposition -> Arc pointer batch -> host
pre_c1_flows.apple: No existing InkPlayground extracted-event adapter contract

target_design.common_batch: PlatformPointerBatch carries source/pointer/generation, phase, coordinates, timestamp, provenance, capabilities, contact and tilt
target_design.ingress: PlatformInteractionIngress owns generation, lifecycle, cancel/source-lost and emits typed normalized records
target_design.capture_gate: PassThroughInputCaptureGate is a host-neutral capture decision seam
target_design.composition: common InkPlayground controller consumes ingress actions; Arc conversion remains common integration fanout only
target_design.platform_mapping: Web/Android/Windows extract native facts and submit bounded batches; Apple adapter maps portable extracted facts
